summary: Frontend-only E2E test of the redesigned Purchase Bills section (trader-grouped). All 8 requested behaviours verified end-to-end on the preview URL. Created 3 bills across 2 traders (Balaji 13900 unpaid, Balaji 1100 unpaid, Krishna 5000 paid) via the + button, then verified summary, trader grouping, trader detail bills, tap-through to edit form, and trader search (incl. empty-state and clear).
critical_code_review_comments: app/purchase/index.tsx: trader group key is normalised lowercase but the search uses the display name only via g.name.toLowerCase(); consistent (fine). Phone match uses substring only — OK for MVP.
src/lib/purchase.ts: billPayment gracefully falls back to binary paid flag while honouring optional paidAmount — good forward-compat.
Trader detail totals recomputed inline instead of reusing groupByTrader — minor duplication but acceptable given single-trader scope.
seed_data_creation: Created 3 purchase bills at runtime via UI (Balaji 13900 unpaid, Balaji 1100 unpaid, Krishna 5000 paid). Stored in browser localStorage only.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Purchase Bills flow works fully. Testids used: purchase-new, purchase-summary-total/pending/outstanding, purchase-trader-search, purchase-trader-search-clear, trader-row-<lowercase-name>, trader-summary, trader-bill-row-<id>. Data persists in localStorage across reloads on same browser session — clear if re-testing from empty state.

verified_behaviours.trader_grouping: trader-row-balaji (2 bills, Purchase ₹15,000, Outstanding ₹15,000) and trader-row-krishna (1 bill, Purchase ₹5,000, Cleared)
verified_behaviours.trader_detail_bills: Both Balaji bills show status 'Unpaid', Paid ₹0, Remaining = bill amount; trader-summary reads Total Purchase ₹15,000 / Pending 2 / Outstanding ₹15,000
verified_behaviours.krishna_paid_bill_expected: Krishna row shows ₹0 outstanding & Cleared — consistent with Paid status semantics
verified_behaviours.tap_bill_opens_edit_form: Navigated to /purchase/<id> and PurchaseForm rendered with purchase-trader field visible
verified_behaviours.search_empty_state: Query 'xyzzz' rendered 'No traders match your search' empty state
verified_behaviours.clear_restores_list: Both trader rows visible again after purchase-trader-search-clear
